projects.title: ApexERP — Enterprise Operations System
projects.shortDescription: A modular enterprise resource planning platform engineered for manufacturing inventory and logistics management.
projects.overview: ApexERP was designed to unify fragmented spreadsheets and legacy desktop software into a cohesive, cloud-based platform. The system handles inventory lifecycle tracking, role-based requisition workflows, and real-time vendor management across multiple warehouse locations.
projects.problem: The client experienced recurring inventory discrepancies, delayed procurement approvals, and poor visibility into inter-warehouse stock movements, resulting in operational bottlenecks.
projects.solution: AIVSTACK architected an end-to-end ERP with granular permission matrices, automated low-stock triggers, barcode scanning support, and real-time analytical dashboards.
features: Multi-warehouse inventory reconciliation
Tiered managerial approval workflows
Audit logging and automated compliance exports
Dynamic PDF quotation and invoice generator
Interactive analytics with predictive restocking forecasts

projects.title: Lumina — Intelligent Enterprise Support Agent
projects.shortDescription: Context-aware conversational AI assistant integrated with internal knowledge bases for automated tier-1 customer inquiries.
projects.overview: Lumina delivers sub-second automated support resolutions by retrieving verified internal documentation through vector search. It securely handles order status inquiries, onboarding tutorials, and troubleshooting diagnostics with seamless human escalation.
projects.problem: Support teams were overwhelmed by repetitive tier-1 tickets during peak product releases, inflating average response times to over 4 hours.
projects.solution: We engineered a custom RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipeline connected to their documentation, integrated with customer ticketing webhooks.
features: Sub-second vector retrieval with hybrid keyword ranking
Automated human agent handoff with conversation summary
Granular analytics on unanswered user intents
Zero training-retention enterprise privacy compliance

projects.title: NovaPay — Cross-Platform Digital Wallet
projects.shortDescription: A Flutter-based consumer fintech application supporting secure peer-to-peer micro-transactions, split bills, and merchant payments.
projects.overview: NovaPay delivers a friction-free payment experience designed for mobile users. Currently undergoing security auditing, the application features biometric authentication, localized banking integrations, and instantaneous bill splitting.
projects.problem: Consumer payment interfaces often suffer from cluttered user experiences, slow authentication handshakes, and unintuitive transaction tracking.
projects.solution: AIVSTACK developed a minimalist, highly responsive Flutter mobile application with micro-interactions and end-to-end tokenized transaction security.
features: Biometric login (Face ID & Fingerprint) with fallback PIN
Instant P2P transfers via QR and contact sync
Multi-party split bill calculator with automated payment links
Offline transaction history caching

projects.title: Aurora — Contemporary Architectural Showcase
projects.shortDescription: A minimalist, editorial web experience engineered for an international architecture studio to showcase landmark residential and commercial projects.
projects.overview: Aurora combines full-bleed architectural photography with smooth page transitions, interactive blueprints, and an integrated client consultation booking engine.
projects.problem: The firm's existing web presence was sluggish, failed to represent their high-end design caliber, and did not accommodate mobile tablets used in client presentations.
projects.solution: We built a bespoke web portfolio with optimized progressive image loading, customized typography hierarchies, and seamless enquiry funnels.
features: Interactive project floorplan explorer
Fluid page transitions with zero cumulative layout shift
Automated image compression and WebP/AVIF delivery
Integrated consultation scheduling system

projects.title: Synapse — Multi-Channel Data Orchestrator
projects.shortDescription: An automated workflow engine that connects marketing leads from multi-ad platforms directly to CRM, slack alerts, and financial ledgers.
projects.overview: Synapse eliminates manual copy-pasting of leads and invoice data across fragmented SaaS tools, reducing data sync delays from hours to seconds.
projects.problem: Sales reps spent over 10 hours a week manually re-keying lead details from landing pages and social campaigns into disparate internal databases.
projects.solution: A custom Python & Node.js orchestration engine featuring webhook listeners, schema deduplication, and automated notifications.
features: Real-time webhook ingestion with automated retry queue
Intelligent lead deduplication and CRM field enrichment
Instant Slack and WhatsApp notification alerts for sales reps

Complete 48-page brand guidelines documentation
Social media design kit with 20+ responsive templates
